reviews.comment: Professor was funny and engaging. Her lections aren't taken very seriously though. She gets her point across. A lot of group assignments, so pick a good group at the beginning. I never had to study real hard for exams and made a good grade. She provides decent study guides. Doesn't have a final, just exams, so that was nice. She has a lot of fun.

I really loved this class shes so sweet and the work wasn't too bad. It was a lot of group projects, 2 exams plus the final. Her and her TA's were very helpful. The lectures were interesting and at the end there's a little attendance quiz.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Though the content is self-explanatory and boring at times, she makes class kinda fun. You can get easily bored so take notes in class. Very easy content, two group projects wasn't bad, midterm and final exam weren't hard either. Just study the slides and the review guide before. She doesn't take attendance but sometimes has in-class assignments.

Prof. Zhu is a good instructor who made lectures enjoyable enough throughout the semester. Your grade is largely determined by a few group assignments so make sure you choose a good group. Grading on these projects can be harsh at times. Use quizlet to memorize the content of the slides before exams and you should be able to well in the course.

Lectures are repetitive, info heavy, and frankly extremely boring.

Attendance is not strictly enforced, but there are random pop quizzes at the ends of classes.

The projects require a lot of work, so pick good teammates.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: First things first, make sure to find yourself a team that knows how to participate (or at the very least, locks in the end). Trust me, it'll help you along the way. Other than that, the professor and TAs are pretty helpful when you need them the most. They give excellent feedback. As for the exams? Just come to class, you'll see why. Bring snack.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Her and TA's can tough graders, but they are always accessible outside of class to offer feedback if needed. Group projects throughout the semester, normally groups of 3-4 students just as an fyi. She makes her lectures really engaging and is always there if you have questions about the lectures or any assignments in general.
The class content is a little bit boring but the professor is so sweet and manages to make it engaging. She gave good feedback and taught the content well.

The professor is very nice and explains concepts properly. She's very funny and engages with students. The material is very clear and mostly general knowledge so studying isn't difficult. Your grades are split between quizzes, exams, and assignments which are all group based projects. Make sure you make 2-3 friends on your first day.

She's the GOAT. Most of her exams are straight from the PowerPoints, but beware, they're super specific from the PowerPoints. She responds super quickly to emails & is always super nice! Her & her TAs can be a bit tough on grading with group projects, but ask them for feedback or ask additional questions, and you'll do fine.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lots of group projects so find a solid group of people first week of class! She is such a kind woman who cares about every one of her students success. She cares about what she is teaching and is passionate for architecture. Is always willing to answer questions and help you with anything. Very little reading just projects involving problem solving
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The test are extremely easy and an accumulation of the quizzes which are also very easy. The lecture slides are posted online and she doesn't add much more to them in class but she will randomly take attendance so be mindful of that. The largest grade is a group project that spans over a few weeks so be mindful of the partners you choose.

Professor Zhu is a very sweet professor; however, 212 as a class is not the most engaging. The class is mainly common sense, making it easy to brush off. The majority of your grade will depend on the group project and exams. The project guidelines weren't the clearest in terms of what was needed, so make sure you ask lots of questions.

Exams were based off the slides and not hard. Group project is not hard and it is fun. She provided an extra credit opportunity and was always smiling during class. There's a few quizzes but they're not hard and they have material that will be on exams. Overall,  a calming class that isn't too boring and pretty easy.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Xuemei was a very fun and peppy teacher that loves her work and her students. She has lots of in class options for extra credit by doing pop quizzes that are participation only but the winner gets extra credit. She has a little accent but she is a very funny person. You will do group projects so make your friends early.

I LOVED Prof. Zhu. Her lectures are very informative and clear, the test questions came directly from the slides, so if you studied you were fine. Gives study guides. The group project was a little confusing to follow, but not difficult to complete. She is very sweet and caring, and often made the class interesting and funny. Definitely take her!

Loved this class, could tell she loved what she was teaching. Humorous and comfortable to talk to. Hard to get 100% as there's always something to improve, but its not hard to get an A if you keep up with your notes and ask questions. They give detailed feedback on projects and you will know why you got points off. Most projects are done in groups.

She was a great professor and you can tell she really cares about her work. It's hard to hear her when she's lecturing so make sure to sit near the front. The "minute paper" at the end of class are super easy and act as a way of attendance for the class. Make sure to pick good people for the final project at the end of the semester.

Her organization made this one of the classes I didn't have to worry about, there were two exams and a final group project, but she had smaller assignments in between to give opportunities to improve your grade like minute papers which were mentimeter with a few easy questions and canvas discussions. Also, she has some interactive lectures.

The test questions come straight from the lecture slides, so as long as you have an understanding of the content, that should be enough to earn an A on any one of her tests. The class has many group projects, so be sure to make friends to work on those assignments with. The TA's are very insightful and helpful, always offering support and help.
Don't take her class unnecessarily hard and didn't round my grade up less than a point I got no respect 4 her

Kind professor, willing to help with anything. Lots of group projects, but they aren't very hard. Tests are easy if you go over the lecture slides. She is a great professor. You will love the material if you are an arch student. No HW, I didn't spend any time outside of class focusing on the class. She cares about her students.

Exams aren't too complicated. Try and take good and short notes, it will absolutely be death by powerpoint... so try not to fall asleep. She's a super sweet and caring teacher, and you can always talk to her. Didn't feel pressured and always found good teams for group projects.
Do not take this class. The professor is quite possibly the worst instructor I've ever had. The tests are awful. the lectures are awful. everything about this class is awful.

Do not take this class. She is a terrible teacher. Very unorganized and vague. Tests are extremely specific and lectures are hard to follow. The group projects are awful. This class is not the elective you want to take. It is extremely difficult for a 200 level class. Beware.
This class is not the elective you want. The Prof is nice but the lectures are uninteresting. The class is project heavy and they are major grades.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Lectures feel long because there is a lot of information packed into them, and attendance is mandatory because you are required to submit your lecture notes (they're graded) for every single class within 15 minutes of the end of the lecture. The tests often pull specific info from the PPTs, but no textbook required, just readings posted on canvas.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The lectures were sometimes entertaining.

(2 major projects  30-40%) (Pop quizzes and tests  5-15%) each. Some exams have material that was not thoroughly discussed, so take good notes. Projects were not demanding, but you will have to work in groups. Dr. Zhu is more than willing to help you with concepts that you do not understand, but the material is straight forward.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: 3 tests which are multiple choice, true false, and short answer (taken straight from the ppt slides on ecampus). 1 group project, but it is very extensive so don't wait till the last minute. Attendance is for a grade and she gives pop quizzes so don't miss! I missed 3 days and ended up with a 70 for attendance and a 0 for 2 quizzes.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: She gives out pop quizzes. Attendance is taken for grade everyday. Lot's of group projects. She gets back with you very quickly and gives amazing feedback. She likes for people to participate in activities. Lectures are put together very well. She posts slides online for the lectures. The tests are usually based off of these slides and the info.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Zhu was very sweet and passionate about Social and Behavioral design. Class was always interesting but got boring because of repetition and lengthy lectures. Lots of group projects, including a huge one at the end for the final. Tests were always very easy if you went over the study guide. Would recommend this class!!

This class was really enjoyable. She is hard to understand, as she speaks quickly and is soft-spoken, but the content is not that hard to understand. The topics in the class were interesting and we watched quite a few videos for each section, which was fun. She does assign group projects, so make sure you have a few friends in the class.

Prof Zhu is really hard to understand sometimes but she lectures based off PPs that she posts on ecampus. And everything you need to know for the test is on those PPs. There was 4 tests I think, 1 of which was the midterm and the last was the final. Class is kinda boring, but takes occasional attendance and you get a grade for it.
